item.title: Lawsuits claim Canton police K-9s used as weapons
item.description: Police body worn camera video shows a somewhat chaotic scene on May 30, 2024, when officers encounter Kievin Conver outside of his house.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie family cleared by investigators
item.description: All family members and spouses have been cleared in the alleged abduction of Nancy Guthrie, officials said Monday.

item.title: DeWine commutes sentence of woman in prison for 1993 murder of her husband
item.description: A woman imprisoned for shooting her husband to death in a widely publicized 1993 crime was released on Thursday after Gov. Mike DeWine commuted her sentence.

item.title: 2 killed, 3 injured in Rhode Island ice rink shooting
item.description: Three people are dead, including the suspect, and three others are in critical condition after a shooting at a Rhode Island ice skating rink Monday afternoon.

item.title: NE Ohio forecast: Bask in this warmth!
item.description: Monday evening is partly to mostly cloudy, with temperatures in the lower to mid 40s.

item.title: Arrest made in deadly hit and run on Cleveland's west side
item.description: Police have made an arrest in a deadly hit and run that happened in January.

item.title: I-TEAM: Who was driving a city vehicle in a Cleveland crash?
item.description: The FOX 8 I-Team has uncovered a mystery behind who was driving a city of Cleveland truck involved in an accident. Now hard questions have come up that may only be fully answered in court.

item.title: Suspect charged with murder after man fatally stabbed at Cleveland park: Police
item.description: Cleveland police announced Monday they have arrested a murder suspect after a man was found stabbed at a park on the city's west side Saturday and later died.

item.title: WATCH: Cleveland police help woman off Lake Erie ice
item.description: Two officers are being recognized for their careful but urgent response to a call for help. Earlier this month, Cleveland police were dispatched to a frozen Lake Erie where a woman was reportedly in crisis.

item.title: Part of I-71 closed due to pole fire
item.description: Parts of Interstate 71 are closed in both directions Monday evening due to a pole fire, Middleburg Heights police confirmed to FOX 8.
